questions.stem: Long source documents and persistent embedding throttling block a Search vectorization pipeline. Which TWO adjustments directly address these separate constraints? Select TWO answers.

options.text: Chunk content to fit the embedding model's input limits.
Replace query vectors with unrelated same-length numerical arrays.
Increase chat response length to enlarge embedding input capacity.
Align ingestion demand with available embedding-model quota.
Retry the unchanged workload indefinitely to create more quota.

explanation.whyCorrect: Input size and throughput quota are different embedding constraints. Chunking addresses document size; capacity or scheduling changes address sustained quota exhaustion.

whyDistractorsWrong.C: Chat generation limits do not change embedding limits.
whyDistractorsWrong.E: Retries do not allocate persistent capacity.
whyDistractorsWrong.B: Arbitrary vectors do not preserve semantic retrieval.
